THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE ONLY. The purpose of this notice is solely to see if there is a market that is capable of meeting this requirement.

Place of Performance: Fort Hood, Texas 76544

Period of Performance: (90 days) Subject to Change

Description of service

The Government requires the leasing of equipment that meet the salient characteristics (please see attachment) for a period of 90 days to determine network interoperability and drive future decision points for requirements.

The USG intends to 100% set-aside this acquisition for a small business concern.

All questions must be submitted no later than 2:00 PM Central Time (UTC-5) on May 1, 2026, to both the Contract Specialist and the Contract Officer at the above email addresses. Answers to questions will be provided NLT 2:00 PM Central Time    (UTC-5) on May 3, 2026. 

Questions will only be answered via email.

Your points of contact regarding this requirement are as follows:
Contract Specialist: joshua.s.eash.mil@army.mil
Contracting Officer: tyler.d.tamberelli.mil@army.mil

Please begin subject line on email with "Sources Sought Notice Response Integrated Survivable Private 5G system with Local Edge, Hybrid Cloud, and SATCOM Connectivity"

Please see all attachments.
